seccion.titulo: Do your ads bring leads, or do they bring sales?
seccion.subtitulo: Ask, and it tells you with the numbers in front of you.
seccion.cierre: Today Comando reads and diagnoses your campaigns. Pausing and adjusting budgets from WhatsApp is coming soon.

comandos.u: Which campaign brought the most leads yesterday, and what did each one cost me?
comandos.r: "September leads" brought 21 at US$ 4.10. Next is "Catalog" with 11 at US$ 7.30. The other three added up to 6.

comandos.u: Compare this week with last week: spend, leads and cost per lead.
comandos.r: Spend US$ 1,480 (+6%), 265 leads (+19%), cost per lead US$ 5.58 (−11%). The jump comes from "September leads": it doubled leads on the same budget.

comandos.u: Which ad is spending and bringing nothing?
comandos.r: "Remarketing" has spent US$ 96 in 3 days without a single lead, at a frequency of 4.8: the audience has seen it too often. At 3 days it is still early to pause it; check the audience and look again on Monday.

comandos.u: Why did the cost per lead of "Catalog" go up?
comandos.r: It paid more per thousand impressions (CPM +22%) and the click-through rate fell from 1.4% to 0.9%: the ad is wearing out. The first thing to check is the creative, not the budget.

comandos.u: How much have I spent this month and how many results so far?
comandos.r: US$ 3,120 in September and 571 results: US$ 5.46 each. "September leads" takes 48% of the spend and brings 61% of the results.

casos.resultado: Fewer hours in Ads Manager. Every budget decision, with the numbers in front of you.
